en: Black‑and‑white view of a historic European town square with a large Renaissance-style town hall on the left and a massive twin‑towered Gothic church on the right. In front of the town hall stands an ornate fountain or monument, and the square is bordered by several narrow merchants' houses with awnings and shop signs. The signs on the facades are in German, advertising gold and silverware, furs and clothing, and a café. The overall scene appears early‑20th‑century, with a mostly empty cobblestoned square and a few small carts and pedestrians.
